{"number":2576,"title":"[Crawler] Persistent 500 on /json/version (Host header \u0026#39;karakeep-chrome\u0026#39; rejected)","body":"The crawler fails to connect to Chrome and logs this every 5 seconds:\n\n```\nerror: [Crawler] Failed to connect to the browser instance, will retry in 5 secs: browserType.connectOverCDP: Unexpected status 500 when connecting to http://karakeep-chrome:9222/json/version/.\nThis does not look like a DevTools server, try connecting via ws://.\n```\n\n**Steps to Reproduce:**\n\n- Standard docker-compose.yml with alpine-chrome:123 or :124.\n- BROWSER_WEB_URL=http://karakeep-chrome:9222.\n- docker compose up -d → Crawler logs spam 500 errors.\n\n**Diagnosis from Container:**\n```\ndocker exec -it karakeep-web sh\ncurl http://karakeep-chrome:9222/json/version  \n# → 500 error or HTML response\n```\n\n```\ncurl -H \u0026#34;Host: localhost\u0026#34; http://karakeep-chrome:9222/json/version  \n# → Valid JSON with \u0026#34;webSocketDebuggerUrl\u0026#34;\n```\n\nChrome DevTools rejects non-localhost/non-IP Host headers (Chromium security feature since ~2016). Puppeteer sends Host: karakeep-chrome, triggering the 500.\n\n**Expected Behavior:**\n Crawler auto-connects via BROWSER_WEB_URL without manual Host header workarounds.\n\n    Affects alpine-chrome 123+ (works inconsistently on older tags)\n\n","state":"open","html_url":"https://github.com/karakeep-app/karakeep/issues/2576","user":{"login":"jbtls","id":66072972,"profile_url":"https://github.com/jbtls","avatar_url":"https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/66072972?v=4"},"author_association":"NONE","comments":1,"reactions":{"total_count":8,"+1":8,"-1":0,"laugh":0,"confused":0,"heart":0,"hooray":0,"rocket":0,"eyes":0},"created_at":"2026-03-09T13:35:01Z","updated_at":"2026-03-29T01:33:02Z","has_parent":false,"has_children":false}
